|descr= Creates a sticky note - an information that sticks to the page, even after scrolling.
|param1= content
|descr1= the sticky note content
|param2= position
|descr2= (Optional, default {{hl|top}}) can be {{hl|top}} or {{hl|bottom}}.
|example1= <nowiki>{{Sticky}}</nowiki>
|result1= {{Sticky}}
|example2= <nowiki>{{Sticky|{{Feature|warning|Use '''on'''EventName in [[Config]]!}}}}</nowiki>
|result2= style{{=}}"height: 40em; vertical-align: top" {{!}} {{Sticky|{{Feature|warning|Use '''on'''EventName in [[Config]]!}}}}
|example3= <nowiki>{{Sticky|Jump to [[#top|the top]] of the page|bottom}}</nowiki>
